en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a large outdoor gymnastic or calisthenics display on a raised platform. A group of uniformed young men or boys, wearing light shirts and dark shorts or trousers with suspenders, perform synchronized exercises with rifles or wooden rifles. In front of the platform sits a military band with helmets and instruments, led by a conductor standing at the left edge of the stage. A tall flagpole with a large flag and string bunting dominates the background, along with a tall rectangular scoreboard- or sign-like structure. The scene takes place on an open field, suggesting a public festival or sports event.
